text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is winding down, and...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Raaaghhh! I can keep going! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute has changed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a delectable aroma. Why, my
mouth is
watering already. But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I probably shouldn't. I need to keep
nutrition in
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's really changed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Raaaghhh! I'm just getting started! Hooo
rah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The difference is as plain as day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear that something has put a stop
to her
progressive withdrawal from
racing. What's
more...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just once, I have to convey
my feelings
to Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I don't want to
embarrass
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her promise to Hokko Tarumae has
become a
powerful motivating force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When all is said and done, Umamusume's

relationships with each other are a
driving force
within them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I must say, you're quite talented.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was doing my own thing at the
beginning of
camp.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even though I had let myself go, you
brought me
to this point.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know, if you weren't already a
trainer, I'd
think you'd make a good
caregiver.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I have a hidden talent. My
training
methods appear to work well
with Umamusume
who've already
peaked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I never would have realized it if not
for
Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, everything has come together. I
believe that
I'll be able to run with my
head held high.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The JBC Classic... It's my one chance to
race
against Tarumae, and I want to
make it
unforgettable.
